question: Скільки днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік я маю?
answer: Вам належить 24 календарні дні оплачуваної щорічної відпустки після завершення щонайменше 6 місяців безперервної роботи. Протягом перших 6 місяців відпустка надається пропорційно до тривалості роботи. Відпустка нараховується за календарний рік: з 1 січня право на відпустку скидається до 24 календарних днів. Також є винятки — окремі категорії працівників (наприклад, жінки перед і після пологів, працівники з інвалідністю, працівники, прийняті після військової служби) мають право на відпустку повної тривалості до шестимісячного строку. Зверніть увагу: про попередній графік відпустки потрібно повідомити керівника до 30 січня, а про саму відпустку — за 2 тижні.
expected_answer: 24 календарні дні після 6 місяців безперервної роботи; до того — пропорційно відпрацьованому часу.

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: New employees become eligible to use paid vacation time following 60 days of employment. Vacation hours are front loaded on your anniversary date, with amounts based on length of service: 80 hours for 0-3 years, 120 hours for 3-5 years, and 160 hours for 5+ years (part-time employees receive 40 hours). Note that unused vacation does not roll over to the next year and accrued, unused vacation is not paid out upon separation.
expected_answer: New employees can use vacation after 60 days of employment.

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: You are entitled to 24 calendar days of paid annual leave after completing at least 6 months of continuous employment. During your first 6 months of employment, you are entitled to vacation pro-rated for the duration of your employment. (Note: certain categories of employees — e.g., female employees before/after pregnancy and childbirth or with two or more children under 15 or a child with disabilities, employees with disabilities, employees whose wives are on maternity leave, employees hired following military service, and employees studying in educational institutions — get the full leave earlier.)
expected_answer: The full 24 days after 6 months of continuous employment; before that a pro-rated vacation (some categories get the full leave earlier).

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: In Costa Rica, you are entitled to 18 calendar days of paid annual leave after completing at least 50 weeks of continuous employment. During your first 50 weeks, you accrue vacation on a pro-rated basis for the duration of your employment. Note that certain categories of employees (e.g., pregnant employees and those with two or more children under 15 or a child with disabilities, employees with disabilities, employees whose wives are on maternity leave, employees hired after military service, and employees studying who wish to use leave for exams/thesis) are entitled to the full annual leave before the 50-week period.
expected_answer: The full 18 days after 50 weeks of continuous employment; before that a pro-rated vacation (some categories get the full leave earlier).

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: You can take vacation in minimum increments of 4 hours.
expected_answer: Vacation may be used in minimum 4-hour increments.

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: Normally, if you divide your annual leave, the main continuous part must be at least 14 calendar days. The second part can be requested in minimum 3-day increments. During martial law, vacation can be requested in minimum 1-day increments.
expected_answer: The main part must be at least 14 calendar days, the rest in minimum 3-day increments; during martial law vacation can be taken in 1-day increments.

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: Under the Costa Rica vacation policy, annual leave may be divided into parts. The main continuous part must be at least 14 calendar days, and the second part can be requested in minimum 3-day increments. So the minimum amount you can take at once is 3 days (for the second part), and 2 weeks' notice is required before taking vacation leave.
expected_answer: The main part must be at least 14 calendar days, the rest in minimum 3-day increments (no martial-law exception).

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: It Company observes six US holidays: New Year Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day. Employees also get 5 additional floating holidays to celebrate Ukrainian public holidays at their discretion. No more than 1 paid holiday can be taken in a 30-day period, and 4 days’ notice is required before taking paid days off or working on a paid holiday. If a holiday falls on Saturday or Sunday, it is observed the following Monday.
expected_answer: Six US holidays (New Year, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) plus 5 floating days for Ukrainian public holidays.

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: It Company observes these Costa Rican public holidays: New Year's Day (January 1), Juan Santamaría Day (April 11), Labour Day (May 1), Guanacaste Day (July 25), Independence Day (September 15), and Christmas Day (December 25). Employees also get 7 additional floating holidays. No more than 1 paid holiday can be taken in a 30-day period, and 4 days' notice is required. If a holiday falls on Saturday or Sunday, it is observed the following Monday.
expected_answer: New Year's Day, Juan Santamaría Day, Labour Day, Guanacaste Day, Independence Day (September 15), Christmas Day.

question: How many floating holidays do I get?

expected_answer: 7 floating holidays; no more than 1 per 30 days, 4 days' notice.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: Sick leave is paid. Under the New York City Safe and Sick Leave policy, employees who work in New York City receive a grant of 40 hours of paid safe and sick time at the start of employment and again at the start of each calendar year. It is paid at the same rate the employee earns at the time the time is used (but no less than the applicable minimum wage), and it is paid no later than the payday for the next regular payroll period beginning after the time was used. Time may be used in minimum increments of 4 hours and no more than 40 hours may be used in a calendar year. Unused safe and sick time does not carry over to the next calendar year and is not paid out at separation.
expected_answer: Employees working in New York City get 40 hours of paid safe and sick time per calendar year, paid at their regular rate; longer off-the-job illness — statutory short-term disability, 50% of average wages up to $170 a week from the 8th day.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: Sick leave is paid for up to 4 months if the illness or injury is confirmed by a sick leave certificate from a medical institution. The employer compensates the first 5 days, and the rest is compensated by the Social Insurance Fund. The Fund's compensation depends on your seniority: less than 6 months of employment — based on minimum wage; 0–3 years — 50% of average salary; 3–5 years — 60%; 5–8 years — 70%; 8+ years — 100% of average salary.
expected_answer: Up to 4 months with a medical certificate; the first 5 days are paid by the employer, the rest by the Social Insurance Fund at 50–100% of average salary depending on seniority.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: In Costa Rica, employees are entitled to up to 4 months of paid sick leave for illness or injury confirmed by a sick leave certificate (or equivalent document) from the CCSS or another medical institution. For the first 3 days, the employer pays 50% of the employee's salary; from the 4th day onward, the CCSS pays 60% of the employee's average salary.
expected_answer: For the first 3 days the employer pays 50% of salary; from the 4th day the CCSS pays 60% of average salary.

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: У довіднику немає окремої політики «декретної відпустки», але вагітність і післяпологовий період регулюються двома програмами (для співробітників у США): 1) Statutory Short-Term Disability Benefits — вагітність покривається короткостроковою непрацездатністю: виплачується 50% середнього заробітку (за попередні 8 тижнів), максимум $170 на тиждень; перші 7 днів — неоплачуваний період очікування, виплати починаються з 8-го дня; максимум 26 тижнів протягом 52-тижневого періоду. Для вагітності жінки покриті 6 тижнів після нормальних пологів і 8 тижнів після кесаревого розтину (може бути продовжено за наявності ускладнень). 2) State Paid Family Leave — для зв'язку з дитиною (bonding) протягом перших 12 місяців після народження: до 12 тижнів у межах 52-тижневого періоду, оплата 67% середнього тижневого заробітку (до 67% середньої зарплати по штату). Зауважте: PFL не можна використовувати для вагітності чи власного стану здоров'я біологічної матері, і він не може застосовуватися одночасно зі short-term disability.
expected_answer: Statutory short-term disability: 6 тижнів після звичайних пологів (8 — після кесаревого), 50% середньої зарплати, до $170 на тиждень; плюс до 12 тижнів Paid Family Leave для догляду за дитиною (67% зарплати).

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: В Україні декретна (материнська) відпустка триває 126 оплачуваних календарних днів: 70 днів до очікуваної дати пологів і 56 днів після народження дитини. Вона оплачується Фондом соціального страхування у розмірі 100% середньої заробітної плати працівниці.
expected_answer: 126 календарних днів (70 до пологів і 56 після), 100% середньої зарплати від Фонду соціального страхування.

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: У Коста-Риці декретна (материнська) відпустка триває 4 місяці: 1 місяць до очікуваної дати пологів і 3 місяці після народження дитини. Вона оплачується у розмірі 100% зарплати співробітниці: 50% сплачує роботодавець і 50% — CCSS (Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social).
expected_answer: 4 місяці: 1 до пологів і 3 після; 100% зарплати — 50% платить роботодавець і 50% CCSS.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?
answer: The handbook does not contain a separate, gender-specific paternity leave policy. The closest applicable benefit is New York State Paid Family Leave (PFL), which is available to eligible employees regardless of gender for bonding with a child during the first 12 months after birth, adoption or foster care placement. Under PFL, eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks within any 52-consecutive-week period, and it is partially paid: 67% of the employee's average weekly wage, capped at 67% of the state average weekly wage. PFL is funded solely through employee payroll deductions. Eligibility requires a regular schedule of 20 or more hours per week plus at least 26 consecutive weeks of employment, or fewer than 20 hours per week plus at least 175 days worked. Note that PFL cannot be used for the birth mother's pregnancy or prenatal conditions or for the employee's own health condition. For specifics of your situation, please contact the Head of Human Resources.
expected_answer: No separate paternity leave; Paid Family Leave gives up to 12 weeks to bond with a child, paid at 67% of the average weekly wage.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?

expected_answer: 2 weeks of unpaid leave; a father can also take over the mother's maternity leave if she has returned to work.

expected_answer: 8 days of paid leave; a father can also take over the mother's maternity leave if she has returned to work.

answer: Yes. In Costa Rica, employees receive an annual 13th-month salary (aguinaldo) equal to one twelfth of the total salary earned from December 1 of the previous year to November 30 of the current year. It is paid no later than December 20.
expected_answer: Yes — the aguinaldo, one twelfth of the salary earned from December 1 to November 30, paid no later than December 20.
